requirements.statement: Shoppers can browse the product catalog

criteria.must: The catalog page lists available products with name, photo, and price
A product with zero stock is shown as sold out rather than purchasable

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view a product's details before buying

criteria.must: The product detail view shows photos, description, price, and availability

requirements.statement: Shoppers can search and filter the catalog

criteria.must: Entering a search term returns only products matching that term
Filtering by category or price range narrows the displayed products accordingly

requirements.statement: Shoppers can add products to a cart

criteria.must: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart's item count
The cart cannot accept a quantity of a product greater than its available stock

requirements.statement: Shoppers can update or remove items in their cart

criteria.must: Changing an item's quantity in the cart updates the cart's subtotal and total
Removing an item from the cart deletes it from the cart's contents

requirements.statement: Shoppers must sign in before checking out

criteria.must: An unauthenticated shopper attempting checkout is redirected to sign in
A signed-in shopper can proceed to the checkout screen

requirements.statement: Shoppers can pay for their order by card

criteria.must: A successful card payment places the order and shows a paid status
A declined card payment does not place the order and shows an error

requirements.statement: Shoppers receive an email confirmation after placing an order

criteria.must: A confirmation email is sent to the shopper's address after a successful order

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view their past orders

criteria.must: The order history view lists only the signed-in shopper's own past orders
Selecting a past order shows its items, quantities, and total

requirements.statement: The store admin can create, edit, and remove products in the catalog

criteria.must: Creating a product adds it to the catalog visible to shoppers
Editing a product's details updates what shoppers see for that product
Removing a product deletes it from the catalog shoppers can browse
A non-admin shopper cannot create, edit, or remove products

requirements.statement: The store admin can set and update stock quantity per product, with automatic sold-out marking

criteria.must: Setting a product's stock quantity to zero marks it unavailable to shoppers
Increasing a product's stock quantity above zero makes it purchasable again

requirements.statement: The store admin can view incoming orders to fulfill them

criteria.must: The admin orders view lists all orders placed by any shopper
A non-admin shopper cannot access the admin orders view
